originals.citation: Hussain, I., Kosseim, L., & Ormandjieva, O. (2013). Approximation of COSMIC functional size to support early effort estimation in Agile. Data & Knowledge Engineering.

quote: Hussain, Kosseim and Ormandjieva (HKO) proposed a method that can be used to automatically classify textual requirements with respect to their COSMIC functional size. ... Objective: To provide external validation of the HKO method
notes: @hussain2008 is an earlier HKO paper on non-functional requirements, not the COSMIC method.
